submitted_record.type: all-dimension theorem using established external PFR
submitted_record.statement: Every admissible k-colour midpoint partition of F_3^n with remainder density at least 1/10 has an affine subspace in R of codimension O(k log(2k)).
submitted_record.extension: Over each fixed odd prime p, density alpha>0 gives codimension O_p(k(log(2k)+log(1/alpha))).
submitted_record.source_comparison: Theorem 3 of arXiv:2610.11847v1 gives O(k^2) at p=3 and alpha=1/10.
submitted_record.remaining: The exact extremal function and removal of the logarithmic factor are not determined.

records.title: auxiliary general lemma
records.statement: If A is covered by M cosets of H, s <= dim(W/H), and M p^(-s)<1, then an affine codimension-s subspace avoiding A exists on which any nonnegative function has average at most its ambient average divided by 1-M p^(-s).
records.remaining: No small-doubling or midpoint hypothesis is required for this standalone lemma. Full catalog target remains unresolved; internal review, no external peer review or worldwide-priority claim.

records.title: explicit companion construction
records.statement: For n>=kb, the remainder with every one of k disjoint b-dimensional blocks nonzero admits k midpoint colours on its complement and has largest affine subspace dimension exactly n-k; density is (1-p^(-b))^k.
records.remaining: The primary source already notes linear-loss constructions; no priority claim for necessity of linear loss. Full catalog target remains unresolved; internal review, no external peer review or worldwide-priority claim.

records.title: Tail exponent rigidity and ascent
records.statement: For a law with full support on N_0 and -log p_n=c*n^beta+o(n^beta), its coordinate ratio-gradient G_n/(c*n^beta) tends to 1+rho-2*rho*min(1,2^(1-beta)). Stationarity at rho>1 therefore requires beta=log_2(4*rho/(1+rho)). Nonzero coefficient gives a strict finite-coordinate ascent direction.
records.remaining: One-sided full support and stated regular tail required; no existence or sufficiency claim. Full catalog target remains unresolved; internal review, no external peer review or worldwide-priority claim. The upper bound two is unchanged; Q4659 is not settled.
